run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: Not a blind first draw. Geometry is emitted by a Python generator and was revised five times, with a headless-Chromium screenshot after each revision, so the submitted file is the fifth render rather than the first. Every revision changed the drawing, not just formatting: v1 had the shin pivot around the hip because nested CSS transforms resolve transform-origin in the parent's rotated space; v2 moved the shin to an absolute sibling; v3 redrew the bill, pouch and wing and reordered the pelican so the neck sits behind the body; v4 thinned the legs and pointed the bill; v5 raised the hip so the thigh is tucked under the belly. The submitted bytes were never hand-edited, so postProcessing stays none. Animation is CSS only: wheel and crank rotation at 1.7 s per turn, a two-bone IK solve for both legs baked into 24 keyframes per revolution so the feet stay on the pedal spindles, a 4 px body bob, a head nod, a scrolling road and drifting clouds.
